name: Hide Node Title
description: Hides a node's title when a per-node 'hide title' field is checked.
project_description:
This module provides a simpler implementation to the Exclude Node Title module. It allows you to hide the title for standard content types and content types using

display suite.

 Instructions for Use

 Pre-requisite, if your using nested fieldsets group them using 'htmlelement'

 1) Add a checkbox field with the machine name "field_hide_title" to your content type and place with the title for easy editor use.

 Once in place it should be easy for the content editor to hide the title of a page as needed.
